items.title: Add optional audit-only outcome fields to the Finding type
items.context: types.ts Finding: add optional signatureTag, resolutionType (enum), dismissReasonType (enum), resolveEvidenceStrength, dismissEvidenceStrength. Each annotated // audit-only — MUST NOT be read by any gate. Additive only; excluded from the finding signature domain.
items.userSees: Build is clean; the Finding type carries the new optional fields with audit-only comments; finding-verify signing is unchanged.

items.title: Capture the fields in finding_add/resolve/dismiss with optional enums and back-compat
items.context: cli-engine.ts schemas: finding_add += signatureTag?; finding_resolve += resolutionType?/resolveEvidenceStrength?; finding_dismiss += dismissReasonType?(OPTIONAL)/dismissEvidenceStrength?. finding.ts handlers: validate enums (reuse the evidenceState validation pattern) and store the fields. Legacy callers omitting the fields behave exactly as before.
items.userSees: finding_resolve/dismiss/add accept the new optional flags and persist them; omitting them works unchanged (back-compat); invalid enum values are rejected with a clear error.

items.title: Signature-registry in learning-store + minimal CLI; auto-propose on capture; gate-exclusion guardrail
items.context: learning-store.ts: read/write .lattice/learning/signature-registry.json (tags: {tag,status:active|proposed|deprecated,aliases,mergedInto,createdBy,approvedBy}). finding_add with a new signatureTag auto-records it as proposed. Add a minimal CLI (signature_registry_list + signature_registry_set with action propose|approve|alias|deprecate; active requires explicit approve) via a new handler + registry/cli-engine entries. Determinism guardrail: advisory.ts and gate logic never read signatureTag/resolutionType/dismissReasonType/evidenceStrength.
items.userSees: signature_registry_list shows tags; signature_registry_set --action=approve flips a proposed tag to active; a finding_add with an unregistered signatureTag leaves it status=proposed; advisory gate behavior is unchanged by any audit field.

items.title: Smoke + npm script + no regression (back-compat, gate-exclusion, migration, signal enrichment)
items.context: tasks/experience-layer-finding-enums-smoke.ts + package.json test:experience-layer-finding-enums. Assert: optional capture + enum validation; legacy finding without fields unchanged (migration tolerance); audit fields NOT read by advisory.ts gate decision; signature-registry propose/approve/alias/mergedInto; finding-signals now produces non-zero signalScore when enums present. No regression in existing finding/usage-ledger smokes.
items.userSees: npm run test:experience-layer-finding-enums exits 0 'smoke passed'; committed verifier prints TOTAL N | PASS N | FAIL 0; existing finding-related smokes still pass.
